issuer.label: Issuer
issuer.confirmMessage: Changing the issuer immediately invalidates every active admin session, including your own — you will need to log in again.
issuer.expirationGenericError: Failed to save the expiration time

keys.heading: Signing and encryption keys
keys.publicKeyDescription: Used by the server to verify the signature of an admin session token — confirms the token has not been forged or modified.
keys.privateKeyDescription: Used by the server to sign session tokens issued after an admin logs in (JWS, RS256 algorithm). Never leaves the server.
keys.secretKeyDescription: Encrypts the admin session token (JWE, AES-256-GCM), so its contents are unreadable to anyone other than the server.

regenerateModal.confirmWarning: This immediately invalidates every active admin session, including your own — everyone will need to log in again.
regenerateModal.revealWarning: Save the secret key now — it will not be shown again.
